description: Títulos de Asignación para Desarrollo Propio para la exploración y extracción de hidrocarburos is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía (SENER). Listado de Títulos de Asignación para Desarrollo Propio vigentes que le dan derecho a Petróleos Mexicanos de continuar realizando actividades de exploración y extracción de hidrocarburos. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía (SENER). Its tags are actividad petrolera, consumo petróleo, exploración, explotación hidrocarburos, extracción petróleo. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
